amr_kw_only.oql: works where keyword is (antimicrobial-resistance) and not title/abstract has ("antimicrobial resistance")

amr_kw_only_noabs.oql: works where keyword is (antimicrobial-resistance) and not title/abstract has ("antimicrobial resistance") and has abstract is (false)

remote_kw_only.oql: works where (keyword is (remote-work) and keyword is (employee-well-being or employee-health or work-life-balance)) and not (title/abstract has (stemmed "remote work" and (wellbeing or "well-being")))

remote_phrase.oql: works where title/abstract has (stemmed "remote work" and (wellbeing or "well-being"))
